description.desc_thousand_char: Tetra-Pak India Private Limited (TPIPL), as per its annual filings, is engaged in the business of liquid packaging solutions and related products provided mainly to the dairy, spirits, and food processing industries. The company also provides bookkeeping and accounting services to the other companies of the holding company. TPIPL is It offers solutions to the categories such as cheese, food, ice cream, juice, nectar, and still drinks, powder, food supplements and nutrition, and many more. It was incorporated in 1987 and has its registered office located in Maharashtra.
